title: binding, returning, the value side of a comma, and a collected array each transfer ownership and are accepted
notes: specification/failures.mdx:136: 'A Result MUST be treated as a must-use value. A source program MUST NOT silently discard a Result without returning, matching, transforming, inspecting, or unwrapping it.' specification/type-system.mdx:56: 'An ignored Result MUST be a compile error.' The over-correction guard for the seven discard spellings pinned beside it. A rule that starts at the producer and walks outward through every container position is one wrong step away from charging ordinary code: a bound Result that IS later consumed, a plain `return`, a comma whose value is used, and an array handed to `Result.all` are all ownership transfers, not discards. This repository has shipped six over-corrections; a corpus that only pins refusals invites the seventh.
